metadata.title: The Cindergate Road
metadata.premise: In a war-scarred old world of wizards and wild borderlands, every expedition sent to reopen the vital Cindergate Road through the Greywood has vanished — until one broken scout stumbles back with a map and a reason to try again.
metadata.narrationVoice: A weary court chronicler's voice, formal diction roughened by wilderness grit.

contentLimits.note: No children appear on-screen in danger.

beats.title: The Petitioner's Hall
beats.prose: The Duchess of Vaelmar receives you beneath cracked frescoes of an older, unbroken realm. The Cindergate Road once fed her war-starved duchy from the far markets; now it swallows every company sent to reclaim it. She offers you the writ others refused.
beats.readAloud: "Three companies. Three silences. You are the fourth, and perhaps the last I can afford to send."

options.label: Take up the writ and ride out at once
Press the Duchess about what happened to the lost expeditions
Bargain for more coin and men before you go

beats.title: The Ashbound Watch
beats.prose: At the edge of the Greywood stands a tower of the Ashbound Circle, wizards who ward the border for their own old reasons. Magistrix Orvenna studies your writ with a wary eye and offers her Circle's escort — for a price unspoken.
beats.readAloud: "The wood does not forget who enters it uninvited," she says. "Go with us, or go alone. Either way, go carefully."

options.label: Accept the Ashbound Circle's escort into the Greywood
Refuse their help and trust your own company
Ask the Magistrix what became of the vanished scouts

beats.title: The Waystone Ruins
beats.prose: Toppled waystones mark the old road's first mile, their runes half-erased by moss and war. Fresh gouges in the stone suggest something recent passed this way — or was dragged.
beats.readAloud: Beneath a fallen lintel, a rune still glows faintly, as if waiting for someone to read it correctly.

options.label: Study the runes for a safe route ahead
Search the ruins for the last expedition's supplies
Press onward without delay

beats.title: Where the Road Splits
beats.prose: The Cindergate Road forks ahead: a low route vanishing into mire-fog, and a ridge trail climbing into wind and stone. Somewhere between them lies whatever has been eating expeditions whole.
beats.readAloud: Neither path shows a single footprint returning.

options.label: Take the low road through the mire
Climb the ridge path instead
Follow the Ashbound escort's hidden trail

beats.title: The Sinking Mire
beats.prose: Black water swallows the road here, hiding old wreckage beneath its skin. Something disturbs the reeds just out of sight, patient as the fog.
beats.readAloud: The mud pulls at your boots like it remembers the taste of the last company that tried this.

options.label: Wade through carefully, testing every step
Use the recovered supplies as a makeshift bridge
Push through quickly despite the deep water

beats.title: The Ridge Path
beats.prose: Wind claws at the ridge trail, and loose scree threatens to send you tumbling. Far below, the mire glints like a wound in the land.
beats.readAloud: From up here you can just see a shape that might be a watchtower, or might be a cairn.

options.label: Follow the safe route marked by the runes
Navigate by starlight and instinct
Signal the Ashbound watchtower for guidance

beats.title: Ambush at Thornreach
beats.prose: Riders in mismatched war-plate burst from the brush — the Thornreach Warband, deserters turned toll-takers, wolves loping at their heels.
beats.readAloud: "Toll for the road!" their leader laughs, though you both know no toll was ever collected and returned.

beats.title: The Sealed Cairn
beats.prose: A cairn of black stone blocks the road entirely, sealed with a ward older than the war itself. Scratched into its base, in a dozen hands, are names — the missing.
beats.readAloud: The seal hums faintly when you approach, as if recognizing that you, too, might soon be a name on the stone.

options.label: Decipher the seal using arcane knowledge
Force the seal open with brute strength
Use the Ashbound escort's key-rune to open the seal

beats.title: The Lost Expedition
beats.prose: Beyond the cairn lies a camp long overrun: tents rotted to lace, a broken standard, and at its center, remarkably whole, the body of a Vaelmar scout — Warden Iss Cael, if the signet ring is any clue.
beats.readAloud: His journal lies open, the last entry unfinished mid-word, as if something interrupted him gently.

options.label: Read the fallen scout's journal
Recover the scout's signet ring for the Duchess
Search for a hidden second supply cache

beats.title: The Hollow Chapel
beats.prose: A ruined wayside chapel stands past the camp, and within it, unmistakably, the translucent shade of Warden Iss Cael himself — bound to the place by whatever took his life.
beats.readAloud: "You found my road," the ghost says. "Good. Now let me tell you why it eats travelers, and why I could not stop it alone."

options.label: Speak with the spectral Warden Cael and win his trust
Banish the restless spirit to grant it peace
Recall what the Magistrix told you about the vanished scouts

beats.title: The Gate to the Cindergate Vault
beats.prose: Beyond the chapel, a war-scarred vault gate stands ajar: the true heart of the road's ruin, held by the deserter-captain Rathe Bellorn and the dead he's raised to guard his toll.
beats.readAloud: Firelight flickers within. You hear Rathe's voice, and beneath it, the dry rattle of bones that should not move.

options.label: Storm the vault and confront Captain Rathe head-on
Offer Rathe a truce and a share of the road's toll
Slip into the vault unseen, guided by the warden's ghost

beats.title: The Cindergate Vault
beats.prose: Captain Rathe Bellorn stands amid stacked coffers and stolen banners, skeletal guards flanking him — the bones of travelers who never made it home.
beats.readAloud: "You're not the first to reach this room," Rathe sneers, "just the first with the sense to be afraid."

beats.title: The Road Reopened
beats.prose: With Rathe fallen and his bone-guard scattered to dust, you plant the Duchess's banner at the vault's threshold. Within a season, wagons roll where only silence walked before. The Cindergate Road belongs to the living again.
beats.readAloud: Somewhere behind you, you swear the warden's ghost finally sighs — and is gone.

beats.title: An Uneasy Truce
beats.prose: Rathe takes your offer, and the road reopens under an arrangement no one back in Vaelmar will ever fully approve of: a toll paid quietly, a war-band left to police the wood in the Duchess's name, in all but title.
beats.readAloud: The Duchess reads your report twice, then locks it in a drawer. "The road is open," she says. "That will have to be enough."

beats.title: One More Silence
beats.prose: The Greywood keeps its newest names. Somewhere in Vaelmar, the Duchess will wait for a report that never comes, and eventually send another company down a road that still, stubbornly, leads nowhere anyone returns from.
beats.readAloud: The last thing you hear is wind through cairn-stones, patient as ever.
